note: Study 2 (2026-11b): twelve new change requests on public repositories, each pinned to one commit, written 2026-11-09 before any reference list or trial existed. None of them was used in study 2026-11.

tasks.request: Require new users to verify their email address before they can log in.
Let authors change an article's title, and its URL slug with it, without breaking links that were already shared.
Let moderators hide abusive comments, and let the comment's author appeal within 7 days.
Lock users out by username and IP address together instead of by IP address alone, as the new default.
Make sessions roll by default, so that every request extends the session's expiry.
Let every user download all of their data (profile, posts and comments) as a single file.
Replace the integer IDs that the API exposes with UUIDs, while keeping existing API clients working.
Change the default signing digest from SHA-1 to SHA-256.
Store passwords with a stronger hashing scheme without forcing existing users to reset their passwords.
Make every to-do list and item belong to a tenant, so that each company only sees its own data.
Let pet owners book visits online, without two visits being booked for the same vet at the same time.
Make the session middleware's cookie Secure and SameSite=Strict by default.
